summary: Frontend-only validation of the zone-scoped Favorites fix in AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx (bug: 'Business ↔ Infra & Dev tabs show identical screen because favorites overflow the sidebar and push zone sections below the fold'). Seeded 12 mixed favorites into localStorage.pm_admin_fav_items_v1 (5 business + 7 infra), reloaded, and verified per-zone filtering with the correct key. All 5 review-request items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx:760-766 — favItems now correctly filters by ._zone === zone; flatItems is built from visibleSections which already includes BOTH zones (line 706 filters only by allowedZones, not active zone), so the .filter(it => it._zone === zone) is the effective per-zone gate. Clean fix. No changes needed.
AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx exceeds 1035 LOC (was 996 in iter81) — soft guideline recommendation still applies: split NAV_SECTIONS + ZoneSwitcher + Favorites logic into separate modules.

Favorites persistence uses localStorage without a schema-version bump. If NAV_SECTIONS ever renames item.id values, orphan IDs will silently disappear from favorites — that's acceptable behavior (.filter(Boolean) already handles it), but a one-time migration/notice could be nicer.
test_credentials: Super Admin: danieligna1@gmail.com / 0108 (cookie httpOnly). /app/memory/test_credentials.md still lists only demo admin@propmanage.io — flagged in iter81/iter82 and still not updated.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 12 favorite IDs into localStorage.pm_admin_fav_items_v1 in the automation session (per-browser scope). Cleaned up at end of run via localStorage.removeItem('pm_admin_fav_items_v1'). No server-side data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The zone-scoped favorites fix is verified working with the CORRECT localStorage key `pm_admin_fav_items_v1` (previous smoke had used a wrong key). Sidebar shows exactly the expected per-zone items. Full validation results in the rca_of_the_issue field below. Section counts match iter81: Business=10 sections, Infra=5 sections. Cmd+K palette still finds items in both zones (used 'Sub-admin' as a probe → returned 'Sub-Admini & Permisiuni' from Infra even when user was in Business). Analytics & Growth item is registered under STATISTICI & KPI (business zone) but the section is COLLAPSED by default in the sidebar — items in collapsed sections still exist in the DOM after user expands, and navigation to /admin/analytics-growth loads all 6 KPI cards (VIZITATORI/SESIUNI/CONTURI/SPECIALIȘTI/PROPRIETĂȚI/BOUNCE). No console errors related to favorites.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug RCA: with a large favorites list, the sidebar's ★ FAVORITE section did not filter by active zone → the same tall favorites list rendered on both Business and Infra & Dev, pushing per-zone sections below the fold and creating the illusion of an unchanged screen. Fix applied at AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx line 763-766: `favItems = favIds.map(...).filter(Boolean).filter(it => it._zone === zone)`. Verification (all PASS): (1) BUSINESS zone favorites returned ONLY {strategic_partners_dashboard, city_partners_list, approvals, operating_manual, marketplace_partners_list}, no infra IDs leaked. (2) INFRASTRUCTURE zone favorites returned ONLY {it_team, sub_admins, admin_accounts, settings_control, ai_dev_team, architecture_board, ai_pm}, no business IDs leaked. (3) Sidebar section count differs by zone as expected (10 business vs 5 infra) and remains identical whether favorites are empty or populated. (4) Cmd+K palette still discovers items from BOTH zones (searched 'Sub-admin' from Business → returned Sub-Admini & Permisiuni). (5) Zone persistence via pm_admin_zone works; empty-favorites regression works; admin-nav-growth_analytics is present under Business → STATISTICI & KPI (collapsed by default; expands and navigates to /admin/analytics-growth which loads all 6 KPI cards).
